verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is documented as the product for building a platform or marketplace that moves money between multiple parties. It collects customer payments and automatically pays a portion out to sellers, which covers the split-payment and seller-payout core. Seller onboarding is only implied, through Connect verification-related skills and connected-account references, rather than a documented onboarding flow, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the seller onboarding/KYC flow for connected accounts, detail on split mechanics and per-seller payout configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of Connect marketplace builds

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Collect payments from customers and automatically pay out a portion to sellers or service providers on your marketplace.
Use Connect to build a platform, marketplace, or other business that manages payments and moves money between multiple parties.
The live index lists 8 Stripe-maintained skills: connect-recommend, connect-required-verification-information
